race.comment: Very tricky. TOUGH ROMANCE (13) failed to beat a runner home on resumption at Caulfield Heath but that was a much stronger race, as was the G1 Blue Diamond before a spell. He can be a sharp improver off a freshen and draws for every hope. NO LIMITATION (5) has been about the mark without threatening in two runs back, beaten 1.5 lengths in town second up. Backs up quickly and should go well. YOLO (6) just found one better fresh and should come on from that. Sets up for a nice run and is in the mix. ZIGGY BAMA (9) won narrowly on debut at Ballarat Synthetic. Was well backed there and is expected to improve sharply. DREAM ENUFF (7) resumes with a nice profile, watch the betting.
